description: Ex Thai Sky Airlines TriStar 1, stored at Don Mueang from 2006 and partly broken up in 2016; moved to Chang Chui by September 2016 and fully re-assembled as the centrepiece of the market by September 2017. Noted April 2025.
Composite display airframe using fake glazing and the tail boom of Royal Thai Police 1006; at Chang Chui since February 2018.
